name: bow_waves
title: Boat hull in calm water

intro.text:
A toy boat hull is held still while water flows past it at 0.3 m/s.

What waves does it make?

outro.text:
The hull feels 0.056 N of drag, about the weight of 6 grams. Turning it bow-first is a one-line change (see the README).

OpenFOAM interFoam · VOF · snappyHexMesh

bar_title: Water surface height (mm): dark trough, light crest

captions.text: Seen from above: water flows up the screen at 0.3 m/s past a 15 cm hull held in place.
Starting the flow suddenly sends ripples across the tank. Light is a crest, dark a trough.
This hull meets the water stern-first, so the water piles up against its blunt end.
Behind it, the disturbed water leaves a trail of waves only a millimetre or two high.
Making waves costs energy: it is part of the drag on the hull.
